$comment: The lint findings in code that was written before a rule was adopted, by file and by rule, as counted on the day the rule arrived: { "src/a.ts": { "<rule>": <count> } }. eslint.config.js turns each listed rule off for each listed file, and CI's lint-allowlist-check lints those files with the rules on again and fails when a count differs. Higher is new code, which gets no exception. Lower is a fix, which lowers the count here in the same change. The list only gets shorter (docs/code-style.md).
